```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet")
groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
    horizon = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution > 0 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    horizon = factor(
      horizon,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket = horizon) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prediction_error = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_prediction_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
# Keep only snapshots recorded on the day each market resolved
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Most final-day forecasts cluster near 0% or 100%",
    subtitle = "Distribution of Manifold Markets probabilities on resolution day",
    x = "Forecast probability",
    y = "Number of markets",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
# Slice probability into 10-percentage-point bins from 0 to 1
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(prob_bin = cut(probability, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(prob_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_prob = mean(probability, na.rm = TRUE),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)

# Dashed slope-1 line marks perfect calibration (predicted == actual)
ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_prob, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(color = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Actual YES resolution rates by predicted probability",
    subtitle = "Final-day Manifold Markets calibration across 10-percentage-point probability bins",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES resolution rate",
    size = "Markets (n)",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
